newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Parker & Parsley FY97 upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Parker & Parsley FY97 upped.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc said Wednesday it increased its estimate for Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co's fiscal 1997 earnings to $2.12 a share from $1.89.

-- Hanifen said the move follows Parker & Parsley's announcement of earnings of $0.62 in the fourth quarter compared with a loss of $0.44 one year ago. The results beat Hanifen's estimate of $0.55 and analysts' consensus of $0.52.
-- The gain was mostly fueled by increases in oil and gas prices and declines in interest expense, Hanifen said.
-- Parker & Parsley is an oil and gas exploration and production company. Its shares closed up 7/8 at 35-1/8.
